name: March Hare

revision.note: Rewritten from the human-performer reading to a photoreal CGI animal.

rendering.limits: Hare anatomy throughout; speech by mouth, nose and whisker movement. No clothing, no cartoon face. Sits at the table beside the human Hatter (CHAR-hatter, human performer).

gender_note.quote: then he dipped it into his cup of tea

base_age_note.reason: Persona age (the Hatter's contemporary), kept for voice casting. As an animal: a prime adult buck in spring ('March') condition, rangy and wild.

hair.color: tawny russet-brown flecked with black on the back, sandy flanks, white belly and chin, black-tipped ears, black-topped white tail
hair.style: coarse and unkempt, sticking up in tufts, with wisps of straw caught in the fur
hair.reason: Species colouring; the straw echoes his fur-thatched house (ch006-p80) and 'mad as a March hare'.

eyes.shape: large, round, bulging, set high on the sides of the head, staring and rarely blinking

face.shape: long hare head with a long upper lip, very long black-tipped ears
features: front incisors showing when he speaks
face.default_expression: gloomy one moment, manic the next; stares
face.expressiveness: ear carriage, eye-staring, sudden freezing and bolting starts; no human expressions
face.quote: The March Hare took the watch and looked at it gloomily

build.height_note: Sitting-up height, head top without ears; ears add about 10 cm. Body length 55-65 cm.
build.posture: sits up on a chair at the tea table, forepaws on the table edge to handle the watch and butter knife; leaps up and changes places
build.scale_reference: Alice comes to the tea-party at about two feet high (ch006 end, SUP-003), so sitting up he is roughly her height. He sits beside the human Hatter, who rests an elbow on the Dormouse between them.

marks.description: a butter knife and the Hatter's watch, which he dips in his tea ('It was the best butter')
wisps of straw in the fur
marks.reason: Ties him to his fur-thatched house (ch006-p80).

default_outfit_tone.summary: none: he wears nothing; his look is the tawny brown hare
default_outfit_tone.reason: The text gives him no clothing; per SUP-002 (BIB-0027) the old tweed coat and neckerchief are dropped.

prompt_base_en: photoreal wild brown hare sitting up at a cluttered tea table, coarse unkempt tawny russet fur flecked black with wisps of straw caught in it, very long black-tipped ears, large bulging amber eyes staring, long upper lip and twitching nose, forepaws holding a pocket watch over a teacup, natural hare anatomy, live-action film plate
